name: Cedexis Radar (network measurement)
plain: Real-user network measurement SDK found in LinkedIn Android builds.
meaning: Measures latency and throughput from the phone to many servers, building a map of network performance by carrier and place.

limits.headline: Can maybe measure how fast your connection is, as found inside LinkedIn Android
limits.user_action: Nothing. It may happen while the app is open and loading content
can: Time how fast the network loads from different servers
Send speed measurements to help choose the fastest route
Check your network state with normal Android permissions
cannot: Do the same on iPhone; no evidence was found
Be confirmed; the exact use is not verified
See your messages or profile data
Find your location from speed tests
limits.differs: Seen only in Android builds. No iOS evidence was found.

story.what_it_is: A measurement kit inside an app tests how fast your phone can reach many servers.
story.for_you: You never see it. The app quietly tests a few small downloads while you use it. It may help the app load faster for you, but it also shows your network, carrier and place.
story.for_makers: Makers use real user tests to choose the best cloud or content network for each region and carrier. It builds a live map of internet speed. The same data can also reveal your IP, carrier and area.

use_cases.example: A professional network picks the fastest server for you by testing it from your phone.
A streaming service picks the fastest delivery network for your carrier at 8 PM.
A game studio measures lag to many data centers and matches players to the best one.
A tool compares carriers in a city to find where slow networks hurt sales.
A big store tests page speed on real phones to decide where to host images.
An ad system reads network measurements and IPs to profile where and how you connect.

story.android_note: This kit was found in LinkedIn Android builds, and Android lets it run with the internet permission.
story.ios_note: iPhone apps could do the same with normal network calls, so it is not specific to Android.

linkedin.how: Exodus lists Cedexis Radar in the LinkedIn Android report for 4.1.1012 (Dec 2024 snippet).
